title: cellgrid transform
explanation:
### Description

Demonstrate vtkCellGridTransform applying a rotation to a DG hexahedral mesh, with arrow glyphs showing transformed HCurl vector attributes alongside the original mesh.

**dataset → input → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → scene → output**

- [vtkActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkActor.html) — assigns the mapped geometry to the scene.
- [vtkArrowSource](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkArrowSource.html) — generates a 3D arrow.
- [vtkCellGridCellCenters](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCellGridCellCenters.html) — cell grid cell centers.
- [vtkCellGridComputeSides](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCellGridComputeSides.html) — cell grid compute sides.
- [vtkCellGridMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCellGridMapper.html) — cell grid mapper.
- [vtkCellGridReader](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCellGridReader.html) — cell grid reader.
- [vtkCellGridSidesQuery](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCellGridSidesQuery.html) — cell grid sides query.
- [vtkCellGridToUnstructuredGrid](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCellGridToUnstructuredGrid.html) — cell grid to unstructured grid.
- [vtkCellGridTransform](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCellGridTransform.html) — cell grid transform.
- [vtkFiltersCellGrid](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkFiltersCellGrid.html) — filters cell grid.
- [vtkGlyph3DMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGlyph3DMapper.html) — glyph3d mapper.
- [vtkProperty](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkProperty.html) — property.
- [vtkRenderingCellGrid](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderingCellGrid.html) — rendering cell grid.
- [vtkTransform](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTransform.html) — defines a 4x4 geometric transformation.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
